spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the normalised dash coordinate space that path-length creates (dasharray out of 100 across five different-length shapes) and now also states honestly when the property is absent, contrasting it with the getTotalLength() boilerplate it replaces.

interactive.rationale: Shape selector, draw-progress slider, stroke-width slider, animate and reset — all drive the stage; verified interactively over CDP in this session.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The lede's promise (percentage dash offsets, no getTotalLength()) matches the stage, and the fallback note now explains when the promise does not yet hold in the visitor's browser.

edge_cases.rationale: The unsupported-browser case — previously an actively wrong rendering — is now a first-class, correct, labelled fallback; five path geometries including an open spiral cover length variety.

references.rationale: See-also links https://chromestatus.com/feature/4861677550043136, sibling concepts and the feature index.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite probes the real path-length surface; on this pre-149 browser it correctly fails the property assertions (2 pass / 4 fail), which is the suite doing its job. Suite untouched (immutable).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Cloud-fallback verification, NOT chrome-devtools-mcp (auto-research.md §0 blocker applies): headless Chromium 141 driven over raw CDP — support probe returned false, banner shows the unsupported state, slider at 50% produced stroke-dasharray exactly 0.5 of getTotalLength() (408.2px of 816px heart path), shape switch to star kept the drawn fraction at 0.5 with aria-pressed synced, reset returned dash to 0px and announced it; screenshot at 75% read and clean; console error channel empty. The real path-length rendering on Chrome 149+ was not exercised here.

telemetry_health.rationale: A path-length-supports-probe-ran assert now records the probe outcome; richer interaction asserts (draw-fraction correctness) are not yet emitted.

design_system.rationale: All colours are design-system variables; the new support note uses --bg-stone/--accent-rose/--accent-emerald on charcoal text (AA); buttons overriding background also set color.

accessibility.rationale: Fixed 2026-10-18: the stage SVG's aria-label now reflects shape and drawn percentage live ('star path, 50% drawn' observed), shape buttons expose synced aria-pressed, a visually-hidden role=status region announces slider changes, animation end and reset, and :focus-visible outlines were added. Remaining: the two sliders announce only via the status region on change, not during keyboard arrow adjustments (by design to avoid spam — revisit with aria-valuetext).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v149/css-path-length --merge passes desktop and mobile with no horizontal overflow and clean console/network; sub-44px advisory is on the small shape buttons (≈36px, adjacent with gaps).

guidanceConsulted.query: SVG stroke draw animation progress with prefers-reduced-motion and unsupported CSS fallback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Progress visuals need a programmatic equivalent (status text) and must respect reduced motion.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied: role=status announcements for draw progress/animation end/reset; Animate now jumps straight to the final state under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP run shows status text 'heart path 50% drawn' and 'star path reset to 0%'

guidanceConsulted.query: SVG stroke draw animation progress with prefers-reduced-motion and unsupported CSS fallback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Animated state must respect prefers-reduced-motion and keep a non-animated equivalent.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: applied: reduced-motion branch skips the 1.8s rAF loop and sets the drawn state instantly with an explanatory announcement

openQuestions.title: Verify the native path-length rendering on Chrome 149+
openQuestions.detail: This session verified the fallback branch on Chromium 141 (probe false). Once a 149+ browser is available via chrome-devtools-mcp, verify the supported branch: the probe banner flips to supported, style.pathLength drives the dash in normalised units, and the drawn fraction matches the slider across all five shapes.

openQuestions.title: Expose slider progress during keyboard adjustment
openQuestions.detail: The status region announces on change (release), not during arrow-key adjustment. Consider aria-valuetext on the progress slider ('40% drawn') so keyboard users hear live values without announcement spam.

summary: Weekly hardening pass 2026-10-18 (headless Chromium 141 + raw CDP cloud fallback, not chrome-devtools-mcp): fixed the major open question — the page now probes CSS.supports('path-length','100') up front, shows an honest supported/unsupported banner, and on unsupported browsers drives the stage with the real getTotalLength() fallback instead of misinterpreting '50 51' as user units. CDP evidence: at 50% the computed dasharray is exactly half the measured path length (408.2/816px), shape switching preserves the fraction, reset returns to 0. Both minors fixed too: prefers-reduced-motion skips the animation, and the SVG exposes a live 'shape, N% drawn' name with aria-pressed shape buttons and a status live region. responsive-check passes both classes. Remaining: verify the native branch on Chrome 149+.
